doc_methods.repo: read in the vendor's public documentation repository at the commit named
doc_methods.excerpt: read from search-engine excerpts of the vendor's official page (the build environment's network policy blocked the page itself)
doc_methods.live: observed by running the host in the build environment

test_status.verified: observed working in the build environment; evidence linked
test_status.partial: part of the stage was observed; the evidence says which part
test_status.untested: no access to the host from the build environment; nothing is claimed
test_status.not_applicable: the stage does not exist on this surface

features.name: Method guidance: scan categories, evidence statuses, honest claims
Intake: source hash, metadata, canonical sRGB copy, skeleton template
Measurement: ink boxes, profiles, edges, radius, shadow, role colours
features.needs: Python with numpy, Pillow, scikit-image, scipy

features.name: Validation, annotated scan, scan report, bundles
Font candidate ranking and render-fitted typography
features.needs: Python packages, a Chromium that Playwright can launch, candidate font files

features.name: Reconstruct, pixel and region verification, PNG + SVG export with round trip
Controlled edits verified against the previous revision and the approved baseline
Template persistence across sessions
features.needs: a writable store that outlives the session (~/design-dna), or .dnab bundles the user keeps

local-agent.label: Local agent with a shell
local-agent.summary: Runs the engine on your machine. Everything works once the Python packages and a Chromium browser are installed; python install.py doctor checks both.

hosted-sandbox.label: Hosted code sandbox
hosted-sandbox.summary: The scripts run in the vendor's container. Which packages and browsers it has is not documented for this skill and was not tested; scripts/capabilities.py reports it at the start of a chat. Files do not outlive the sandbox, so download exported bundles.

features.measure: expected if numpy, scikit-image and scipy are present; untested
features.fonts: only if the sandbox can launch Chromium; untested
features.render: only if the sandbox can launch Chromium; untested
features.edit: only if the sandbox can launch Chromium; untested
features.persist: no: download bundles and upload them again

instructions-only.label: Instructions only (fallback)
instructions-only.summary: No code runs. The assistant follows the Design DNA method by eye. Nothing is measured, rendered or verified, and every value is an estimate that it must label as one.

features.edit: no: described changes, not verified ones
features.persist: no: keep the scene JSON and passport the assistant writes
